description: Shopee Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_PARTNER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: partner_key (live key) of the Shopee Open Platform app with the Ads (AMS/Ads) API permission; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_PARTNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).
